sources.use: Cookie events, explicit auth properties and authoritative principal/session validation.
Existing session key is renewed on SignInAsync; force new credential-authentication context to guarantee fresh lookup key.
Framework server ticket-store contract; do not invent a new cookie wire protocol.
Generic errors, authoritative checks, abuse and no silent password truncation.
Rotate authentication identifiers, server expiry/revocation and protected cookie transport.
Protect login and logout from CSRF; same-site cookies do not replace origin/token validation.

technology_decision: No new technology or package. Reuse pinned ASP.NET10/Identity/EF, PostgreSQL, Data Protection, existing policy and @tunner/ui capabilities. Guidance does not establish Product policy values.

runtime_verification.framework_handler_branch: StoreAsync for new credential authentication; existing key RenewAsync must remain disabled
runtime_verification.ef_generation: Existing governed dotnet-ef10.0.12 generated the migration against EF runtime10.0.13; executable no-pending-model/migration tests are required; no package/tool upgrade is introduced.
